text: Lastly, become the person other people turn to for expertise.
This means you need to learn how to write, build,
solve problems, and work directly with other people.
You also have to practice listening actively
You have to practice thinking critically.
Next, you have to carefully weigh the available evidence.
Finally, you take what you know to make informed decisions.
School is where you get to build what you bring to the work.
The opportunity to learn is already in front of you.
Choose something you want to get better at.
